headline: Rajoo Engineers: Kishor Nanalal Doshi files SEBI Regulation 31 disclosure on substantial share acquisition
sum: Kishor Nanalal Doshi submitted a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations 31(4) and 31(5), indicating a substantial acquisition or open offer event at Rajoo Engineers Limited.
detail: The filing with NSE archives confirms submission of a disclosure under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. These provisions mandate disclosure when a person acquires shares triggering the 5% threshold or initiates a takeover. The actual shareholding percentage, consideration, and offer terms are not disclosed in the Bar & Bench summary and would require access to the full NSE/company announcement or the filed disclosure document itself.
